operating_notes.text: Module production reached 12.6 GW in FY26, up 77% YoY.
Order pipeline stands at 100+ GW as of April 2026.
Solar glass plant capacity targeted at 2,500 TPD with ₹3,900 Cr capex.
Waaree Energies sought shareholder approval via postal ballot for a QIP of up to ₹10,000 crores.
Waaree Power completed 100% acquisition of Waaree Semicon Private Limited for ₹1 lakh.
Order book of ₹61,500 Cr equals 25.2 GW, split ~40% domestic India, ~36% domestic US and ~24% exports from India.
Module realisations: exports USD 0.25–0.26/Wp, DCR USD 0.20–0.25/Wp, non-DCR USD 0.13–0.14/Wp; imported cell USD 0.04–0.045/Wp versus in-house cost USD 0.07–0.08/Wp.
US IRA incentive of USD 0.07/Wp accrued USD 12–13 million on ~230 MW in Q1, with 400–500 MW guided from Q3.
Designated person Mithil Gandhi disgorged ₹4.33 lakh for a contra trade violation under SEBI PIT Regulations.
Waaree Solar Americas Inc. commissioned 1.6 GW of new module lines at Brookshire, Texas, taking total facility capacity to 3.2 GW.
Waaree Energies approved acquiring 33.34% of Wictor Sealz Private Limited with an additional ₹5 Cr investment planned by March 31, 2027.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,480.25 Cr (+111.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,061.1 Cr (+71.4% YoY).
Waaree Energies issued an investor presentation guiding for FY27 Operating EBITDA of ₹7,000–7,700 Cr and detailing a ₹30,000 Cr capex plan.
Waaree Energies Ltd signed by Rajesh Ghanshyam Gaur posted Q4 FY26 audited results call recording on April 30, 2026, available at https://waaree.com/investor/schedule-of-analysts/
Waaree Energies scheduled an Investor Day in Mumbai titled Waaree 2.0 UNBOUND for May 7, 2026.
Waaree Energies step-down arm executed a PPA with SECI for a 300 MW wind power project in Dwarka, Gujarat.
Waaree Energies filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹1,937 Cr utilized out of ₹3,600 Cr IPO proceeds.
Waaree Energies hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on April 30, 2026, detailing strategic backward integration and guiding for FY27 operating EBITDA of ₹7,000–7,700 Cr.
Waaree Energies issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for a ₹10,000 Cr QIP and appointment of Jignesh Rathod as CEO.
Waaree Power completed the acquisition of Waaree Semicon for ₹1 lakh on May 15, 2026, making it a step-down subsidiary.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,517.74 Cr (+23.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹718.68 Cr (-14.7% YoY).
Waaree Energies reported an insider trading code violation by a designated person, resulting in a ₹4.33 lakh profit disgorgement to SEBI IPEF.
Waaree Energies presented Q2FY27 results with revenue of ₹7,517.74 Cr and reaffirmed FY27 EBITDA guidance.
Audio recording of Analysts/Institutional Investors Meeting/Call held on October 28, 2026 is available on the company website.
Waaree Energies' US subsidiary commenced commercial production from 1.6 GW of new solar module lines at Brookshire, Texas, taking total facility capacity to 3.2 GW.
Waaree Energies approved acquiring a 33.34% stake in Wictor Sealz Private Limited for ₹33,340 and an additional ₹5 crore investment.
